# ingest

Hook and status-line ingest endpoints, the envelope that binds an event to a Muster session, seq assigned at ingest.

Read first: `docs/features/ingest/spec.md`, `docs/features/ingest/contract.md`

- `kb:adr/canary-refresh-interval-key-canary-only` — The canary writes statusLine.refreshInterval, a settings key production never writes, so the idle-tick fact has a guard. (accepted, 2026-09-12; features: canary, usage, ingest) → `docs/adr/canary-refresh-interval-key-canary-only.md`
- `kb:adr/canary-subagentstop-not-a-surface` — The subagent stop hook is inert to Muster and its inventory row is dropped from the canary; the only subagent dependency is the agent marker on tool hooks. (accepted, 2026-09-10; features: canary, ingest) → `docs/adr/canary-subagentstop-not-a-surface.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-all-hooks-command-wrappers` — Every hook and the status line is a command wrapper that exits silently when unmanaged or when the daemon is down; Muster writes no http hook entries. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: ingest, launch) → `docs/adr/ingest-all-hooks-command-wrappers.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-claude-cwd-read-in-interpret-only` — Claude's working directory is read from the verbatim hook payload in Interpret and from the status line, never added to the raw ingest envelope. (accepted, 2026-10-01; features: ingest) → `docs/adr/ingest-claude-cwd-read-in-interpret-only.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-envelope-authoritative-binding` — Every event is enveloped; a new session_id on an enveloped event is a clear-style rebind, a never-bound session binds on it, raw and status posts never bind. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/ingest-envelope-authoritative-binding.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-envelope-pane-must-corroborate` — An enveloped event routes only when its tmuxPane is present and equals the stored pane; absent or mismatched persists unrouted; empty stored pane routes. (accepted, 2026-09-16; features: ingest) → `docs/adr/ingest-envelope-pane-must-corroborate.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-hook-entries-permanent` — Muster's hook entries in a directory are permanent by design; no reference counting, no strip on shutdown, no strip on remove. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: ingest, launch) → `docs/adr/ingest-hook-entries-permanent.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-monotonic-rebind` — An enveloped event never rebinds a session backwards onto a Claude session_id it has already left; reordered stragglers apply without rebinding. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/ingest-monotonic-rebind.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-separate-token-in-url-path` — Two tokens: the UI token is exchanged for a strict same-site cookie, and a separate ingest token is embedded in the hook URL path. (accepted, 2026-08-20; features: ingest, connection) → `docs/adr/ingest-separate-token-in-url-path.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-seq-assigned-at-ingest` — Events carry no timestamps or order, so the daemon assigns a monotonic seq at ingest, returns 200 at once, and processes asynchronously. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/ingest-seq-assigned-at-ingest.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-shell-quote-at-write-boundary` — MergeSettings single-quotes both command-hook paths at the write boundary; the default data dir with a space stays and nothing else quotes. (accepted, 2026-08-25; features: ingest, launch) → `docs/adr/ingest-shell-quote-at-write-boundary.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-wire-shaped-fixtures-via-claudecodetest` — Tests outside the Claude Code package get wire-shaped bodies from a claudecodetest helper package rather than narrowing the boundary check. (accepted, 2026-08-22; features: ingest) → `docs/adr/ingest-wire-shaped-fixtures-via-claudecodetest.md`
- `kb:adr/ingest-wrapper-scripts-replaced-atomically` — The wrapper scripts are replaced by temp-file-and-rename and skipped when unchanged; serving before startup and a shorter curl timeout were declined. (accepted, 2026-09-26; features: ingest) → `docs/adr/ingest-wrapper-scripts-replaced-atomically.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-project-scoped-settings-not-config-dir` — Muster instruments a directory through project-scoped .claude settings, never through CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, which breaks subscription OAuth. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: launch, ingest) → `docs/adr/launch-project-scoped-settings-not-config-dir.md`
- `kb:adr/launch-settings-local-json-not-settings-json` — Muster writes the gitignored project settings.local.json, which alone honours hooks and status line, so the ingest token never lands in a committable file. (accepted, 2026-08-20; features: launch, ingest) → `docs/adr/launch-settings-local-json-not-settings-json.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-claude-location-from-main-agent-cwd` — Claude's location is read from every main-agent hook's cwd and the status line's working directory; never CwdChanged's target and never subagent-marked events. (accepted, 2026-10-01; features: lifecycle, ingest, card-location) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-claude-location-from-main-agent-cwd.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-session-identity-is-tmux-target` — A Muster session is identified by its tmux target; the Claude session_id is a mutable attribute that /clear replaces in the same pane. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-session-identity-is-tmux-target.md`
- `kb:adr/lifecycle-session-ids-monotonic-never-reused` — Session ids are allocated monotonically from a kv watermark and floored above every muster-N on the socket, so an id is never reissued. (accepted, 2026-09-14; features: lifecycle, launch, ingest) → `docs/adr/lifecycle-session-ids-monotonic-never-reused.md`
- `kb:adr/process-tests-run-space-bearing-data-dir` — Tests execute the generated hook and status-line command strings through sh from a data dir with a space, against a live handler. (accepted, 2026-08-25; features: ingest) → `docs/adr/process-tests-run-space-bearing-data-dir.md`
- `kb:adr/reader-change-signal-is-the-write-hook` — A routed Write, Edit or MultiEdit hook naming a markdown file becomes a docChanged message; freshness is the hook time and absent when no write was seen. (accepted, 2026-09-14; features: reader, ingest) → `docs/adr/reader-change-signal-is-the-write-hook.md`
- `kb:adr/reader-plan-located-by-transcript-scan` — The plan path is derived by scanning the transcript every hook names, on bounded triggers, and persisted on the session row; no watcher, no poll. (accepted, 2026-09-14; features: reader, lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/adr/reader-plan-located-by-transcript-scan.md`
- `kb:adr/rename-pushed-to-claude-via-prompt-hook` — A rename reaches Claude Code via the UserPromptSubmit hook's sessionTitle and --name on resume; it warns on a name a live session holds and reads Claude's back. (accepted, 2026-10-05; features: rename, ingest, launch) → `docs/adr/rename-pushed-to-claude-via-prompt-hook.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-shell-pane-carries-no-session-env` — The shell pane carries no Muster session environment and gets no settings written, so a nested Claude Code fires hooks that persist unrouted. (accepted, 2026-09-05; features: surfaces, ingest) → `docs/adr/surfaces-shell-pane-carries-no-session-env.md`
- `kb:fact/background-tasks-field` — Stop.background_tasks lists running subagents and backgrounded shells with status "running", [] when nothing is outstanding. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.259..2.1.267; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/background-tasks-field.md`
- `kb:fact/bang-command-turn-has-no-prompt-submit` — A `!` shell command typed in the TUI runs, then Claude takes a turn about its output that ends in Stop — with no UserPromptSubmit before it. (active, 2026-10-01; verified 2.1.286..2.1.289; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/bang-command-turn-has-no-prompt-submit.md`
- `kb:fact/clear-mints-new-session-id` — /clear emits SessionEnd{reason:"clear"} for the old session_id, then SessionStart{source:"clear"} with a new id in the same pane. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.237..2.1.289; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/clear-mints-new-session-id.md`
- `kb:fact/command-hooks-inherit-pane-env` — Command hooks and the status-line script inherit the pane environment on every event, ~50 ms per event; an unmanaged session posts nothing. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.237..2.1.289; features: ingest) → `docs/facts/command-hooks-inherit-pane-env.md`
- `kb:fact/cwd-changed-hook` — CwdChanged fires (http and command) after a shell cd with old_cwd/new_cwd; not on EnterWorktree/ExitWorktree, and a reset cd's new_cwd is wrong. (active, 2026-10-01; verified 2.1.286..2.1.289; features: ingest) → `docs/facts/cwd-changed-hook.md`
- `kb:fact/cwd-follows-claude-mid-session` — Hooks' cwd and the status line's cwd/current_dir follow a mid-session cd inside the project or an /add-dir directory; a cd elsewhere resets to the root. (active, 2026-10-01; verified 2.1.286..2.1.289; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/cwd-follows-claude-mid-session.md`
- `kb:fact/enter-worktree-moves-project-dir` — EnterWorktree moves cwd and project_dir into the worktree and adds a status-line worktree object with its branch; launch-time hooks keep firing there. (active, 2026-10-01; verified 2.1.286..2.1.289; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/enter-worktree-moves-project-dir.md`
- `kb:fact/headless-fires-full-hook-sequence` — Headless claude -p fires the full hook sequence, including the command-wrapped SessionStart, so hook probes need no tmux. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.289; features: canary, ingest) → `docs/facts/headless-fires-full-hook-sequence.md`
- `kb:fact/hook-await-per-event` — SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolBatch and Stop hooks are awaited; PostToolUse does not hold the next tool; StopFailure is fire-and-forget. (active, 2026-09-23; verified 2.1.280..2.1.289; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/hook-await-per-event.md`
- `kb:fact/hook-commands-are-shell-lines` — Command-hook command and statusLine.command are /bin/sh -c command lines, not argv paths; an unquoted space-bearing path breaks both. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.245..2.1.289; features: ingest, launch) → `docs/facts/hook-commands-are-shell-lines.md`
- `kb:fact/hook-delivery-best-effort` — Hooks are at-most-once with no timestamps or sequence numbers; kill -9 emits nothing and a SIGTERM emits SessionEnd but no Stop-family event. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: ingest, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/hook-delivery-best-effort.md`
- `kb:fact/hook-output-sets-session-title` — A UserPromptSubmit hook's hookSpecificOutput.sessionTitle renames the session (nameSource "hook"); SessionStart's output accepts the same field. (active, 2026-10-05; verified 2.1.289..2.1.289; features: rename, ingest) → `docs/facts/hook-output-sets-session-title.md`
- `kb:fact/hook-payload-fields` — Per-event hook field inventory: the common set on every hook, prompt_id on all but SessionStart, and each event's own fields. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.289; features: ingest) → `docs/facts/hook-payload-fields.md`
- `kb:fact/local-settings-honoured` — Project-scoped .claude/settings.json and settings.local.json alone each honour hooks, statusLine and allowedHttpHookUrls. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.237..2.1.289; features: launch, ingest) → `docs/facts/local-settings-honoured.md`
- `kb:fact/model-switch-hooks` — /model fires PreModelSwitch and PostModelSwitch (from_model, to_model, source); the status line shows the new model at once, before any prompt. (active, 2026-10-01; verified 2.1.286..2.1.289; features: ingest, lifecycle, usage) → `docs/facts/model-switch-hooks.md`
- `kb:fact/notification-types-observed` — Notification.notification_type: idle_prompt ~60 s after Stop, and permission_prompt sharing PermissionRequest's prompt_id. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.289; features: lifecycle, ingest) → `docs/facts/notification-types-observed.md`
